ucs.title: [LLM] DragonForce affiliate SimpleHelp RMM hijack → discovery / staging chain (CVE-2024-57727)
ucs.description: Hunts the DragonForce affiliate playbook of exploiting an internet-exposed SimpleHelp RMM server (CVE-2024-57727 path traversal) and then driving the existing SimpleHelp agent on downstream MSP-managed endpoints to spawn discovery, credential, and pre-staging binaries. CISA / Sophos attributed this exact chain to a DragonForce affiliate against MSP customers in early 2025.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.process_name) as child_proc values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("Remote_Access_Client.exe","SimpleService.exe","SimpleHelpCustomer.exe","remote_access.exe") OR Processes.parent_process_path="*\\SimpleHelp\\*") AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","nltest.exe","whoami.exe","systeminfo.exe","quser.exe","tasklist.exe","netstat.exe","ipconfig.exe","dsquery.exe","adfind.exe","rundll32.exe","wevtutil.exe","vssadmin.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe","curl.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe") by host Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process span=1h | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | stats min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime values(child_proc) as children dc(process_name) as distinct_children sum(count) as total by host parent_process_name | where distinct_children >= 3 | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
// DragonForce affiliate: SimpleHelp RMM agent spawning discovery / LOLBin fan-out (CVE-2024-57727 follow-on)
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let SimpleHelpParents = dynamic(["remote_access_client.exe","simpleservice.exe","simplehelpcustomer.exe","remote_access.exe","simplehelp.exe"]);
let SusChildren = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","nltest.exe","whoami.exe","systeminfo.exe","quser.exe","tasklist.exe","netstat.exe","ipconfig.exe","dsquery.exe","adfind.exe","rundll32.exe","wevtutil.exe","vssadmin.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe","curl.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (SimpleHelpParents)
   or InitiatingProcessFolderPath has @"\SimpleHelp\"
| where FileName in~ (SusChildren)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            DistinctChildren = dcount(FileName),
            ChildSample = make_set(FileName, 25),
            CmdSample = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 15)
            by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, AccountName
| where DistinctChildren >= 3   // 3 = empirical threshold; benign SimpleHelp sessions rarely fan to >2 unique LOLBins/30d
| order by FirstSeen asc

ucs.title: [LLM] DragonForce locker pre-encryption sabotage chain (shadow copy wipe + recovery disable + service stop)
ucs.description: Hunts the exact pre-encryption sabotage sequence baked into the DragonForce ransomware locker (a LockBit Black / Conti-derived builder): vssadmin/wmic shadow-copy deletion, bcdedit recovery sabotage, wbadmin catalog delete, and bulk service stops (`net stop` of MSSQL/Veeam/Backup Exec) all executed from a single device within minutes — immediately before files are encrypted to .dragonforce_vm_encrypted / similar extensions.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","sc.exe","powershell.exe") AND (Processes.process="*shadowcopy*delete*" OR Processes.process="*shadows*/all*/quiet*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*no*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*" OR Processes.process="*delete*catalog*-quiet*" OR Processes.process="*stop*veeam*" OR Processes.process="*stop*mssql*" OR Processes.process="*stop*sql*" OR Processes.process="*stop*backup*" OR Processes.process="*Set-MpPreference*-DisableRealtimeMonitoring*") by host Processes.process_name span=10m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | stats min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime dc(process_name) as distinct_sabotage_bins values(process_name) as binaries values(cmds) as command_lines by host | where distinct_sabotage_bins >= 3 | eval window_sec=(lastTime-firstTime) | where window_sec < 1800 | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
// DragonForce ransomware pre-encryption sabotage chain (LockBit Black-derived locker)
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let BurstMinutes = 30m;
let Sabotage = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("shadow", "delete"))
         or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
         or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and (ProcessCommandLine has_all ("recoveryenabled", "no") or ProcessCommandLine has_all ("bootstatuspolicy", "ignoreallfailures")))
         or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete", "catalog"))
         or (FileName in~ ("net.exe","net1.exe","sc.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has "stop" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("veeam","mssql","sqlserver","backupexec","msexchange","vss","sophos","sentinelone","acronis"))
         or (FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring","Remove-MpPreference","Stop-Service -Name *veeam*","Stop-Service -Name *sql*"))
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName;
Sabotage
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            DistinctSabotageBins = dcount(FileName),
            Binaries = make_set(FileName),
            Cmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 20),
            Parents = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 10)
            by DeviceName, bin(Timestamp, BurstMinutes)
| where DistinctSabotageBins >= 3   // 3 = require chained sabotage; legitimate backup ops rarely combine vssadmin+bcdedit+net stop
| extend WindowSec = datetime_diff('second', LastSeen, FirstSeen)
| order by FirstSeen asc
ucs.sentinel_kql:

#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i AND regex("shadow.*delete|delete.*shadow", field=CommandLine, flags="i"))

  OR (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i AND regex("recoveryenabled\s+no|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures", field=CommandLine, flags="i"))

| bucket(span=30m, field=@timestamp, function=[count(as=hits), count(field=ImageFileName, distinct=true, as=distinct_sabotage), collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine], multival=true)], limit=200)
